title: Structured exactly-one relational event three-seed capacity training
purpose: Test whether changing only the episode objective from max-MIL to exact-one likelihood yields safe, non-duplicate structural node commits that transfer from C07 policy selection to C08.

approval.scope: One immutable C01-C06 fit/C07 checkpoint-policy selection/C08 one-shot transfer three-seed run; zero C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly delegated best-method choices and continuous execution.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 three-seed raw exit-token cache.
Sealed final unified learned geometry observation features.
Sealed V1 relational training FAIL, state-policy FAIL and exact-one readiness PASS.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and locally trained frozen outputs.

worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Every C01-C06 observation is visited once per epoch in complete episode-preserving batches; no C08 row selects epoch, loss or policy.

teacher.source: Corrected causal junction/terminal class and complete episode membership.
teacher.student_input: Unchanged raw exit tokens and learned geometry context; episode ID is loss-only and never enters forward.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Exact-one likelihood trains one correct commit per episode; deployment additionally uses past-only consensus/stability and provisional refusal.

split.fit: C01-C06 supplies all gradients and frozen normalization.
split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: C07 alone selects minimum exact-one NLL checkpoint and one state policy from the fixed 336-per-event grid.
split.strict_test: C08 receives one unchanged development transfer; C09/C10/M-TARE remain unread.
split.historical_pollution_audit: V1 outputs define baselines only. V2 starts each seed from random initialization and changes only the loss.

methods.main: Three random initializations of the unchanged 240101-parameter relational model, six complete episode-preserving epochs, AdamW and parameter-free exact-one likelihood; ensemble probabilities drive a C07-selected past-only commit policy transferred unchanged to C08.
methods.baseline: V1 max-MIL stateful C07/C08 precision 0.996241/0.997093, recall 0.497186/0.568823 and macro-F1 0.753519/0.796339; pooled-token macro-F1 0.743847.
methods.fallback: If either C07 or C08 misses safety or macro-F1, seal scientific FAIL and stop V2 before strict test or graph.

acceptance.population: Exactly 142184 fit, 21548 C07 and 24394 C08 observations, 3282/533/603 episodes and three seeds.
acceptance.optimization: Three seeds x six epochs x 1111 batches = 19998 optimizer steps; 240101 parameters per seed; perception outputs receive zero updates; C08 selects zero checkpoints.
acceptance.c07_and_c08_safety: Each independently requires aggregate precision>=0.995, false<=0.005, recall>=0.25, junction/terminal precision>=0.99 and recall>=0.25, with all ten families represented.
acceptance.c07_and_c08_gain: Each independently requires decision macro-F1>=0.793847, at least five points above the exact pooled baseline.
acceptance.system: Zero C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner, exact source replay, complete checkpoints/outputs/grid/figures/logs/seal.

failure_policy: Any data, environment, optimizer-count, checkpoint split, policy transfer, safety, gain, family or isolation failure stops and seals FAIL; no changed epochs/loss/grid/gates or graph compensation.
retention: Retain three checkpoints, histories, development outputs, state policy and full grid, stateless diagnostics, paper figure/source, logs, environment, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Three serial deterministic CUDA trainings and one CPU C07/C08 policy evaluation
